title: Harte Hanks Takes Home the Bronze at the Financial Communications Society Awards
summary: See how award-winning financial email campaigns boost engagement and success.
body_markdown:
Harte Hanks takes home the Bronze at the 29th Annual[Financial Communications Society](https://www.linkedin.com/company/financial-communications-society/) Awards in the Email – Consumer Retail category! This recognition honors Harte Hanks’ expertise in crafting effective email campaigns that drive amazing results for our clients.


Kudos to our talented team!
